name: libxsmm-n512-tb-with-timed-neon-a-transpose
hypothesis: Implement the swarm-selected conversion change: replace only the n=512 TB wrapper's SME transpose with NEON 4x4 FP32 microtiles inside 32x32 tiles. Four row loads, register transposes, and four contiguous stores produce at[k*512+i]=A[i*512+k]. Slots [4]=original B, [10]=at, and [16]=original C remain unchanged. This differs from the measured SME-transpose TB source. The hypothesis is lower conversion cost; the complete timed performance effect is unknown. NEON conversion can regress, and prior TB measurements do not isolate conversion cost. Allocation, conversion, dispatch, and free remain inside gemm. Allocation failure retains NN; other sizes retain the existing fallback. All assembly, FP32 accumulation, ABI, thread count, compiler flags, tolerance, and complete BSD notices remain unchanged. No tools or tests were run. Require compilation and correctness checks for fresh inputs, full overwrite, unchanged inputs, general sizes, tails, n<=0, and allocation failure. Measure ten reports and ten fresh alternating NN paired controls with power source and settings unchanged, preserving best-of-three timing. Report spread and comparisons against fresh same-mode peaks and the historical AC Automatic peak 1685.6230608449698; retain the Battery Automatic peak 1668.5964359101147 as separate historical context. Comparator policy remains pending. Adoption requires min(candidate)>1.05*max(paired controls) and the unchanged held-out check. No speedup or goal completion is established.
